linux.post_install:
unpack() { if unzip -tq "$1" > /dev/null 2>&1; then unzip -oq "$1"; else tar -xf "$1"; fi rm -f "$1" } # Node.js runtime (LinuxGSM update_bfe.sh uses the latest v24 release). node_file="$(curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/SHASUMS256.txt | grep -o 'node-v[0-9.]*-linux-x64.tar.xz' | head -n 1)" curl -fL --retry 3 -o node.tar.xz "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/$node_file" rm -rf node && mkdir node tar -xf node.tar.xz -C node --strip-components=1 rm -f node.tar.xz # Battlefront Eternal server files. server_file="$(curl -fsSL https://get.battlefronteternal.com/downloads/latest/SHA256SUMS | grep -o 'battlefront-eternal-server_[^ ]*_linux-x64.tar.xz' | head -n 1)" mkdir -p bfe && cd bfe curl -fL --retry 3 -o gse-download "https://get.battlefronteternal.com/downloads/latest/$server_file" unpack gse-download
# steamclient.so for the Steam API (LinuxGSM fix_steamcmd.sh does the same). for bits in 64 32; do lib="$(find . "$HOME/.steam" "$HOME/.local/share/Steam" -maxdepth 4 -path "*linux$bits/steamclient.so" 2> /dev/null | head -n 1)" if [ -z "$lib" ]; then lib="$(find "$HOME" -maxdepth 5 -path "*steamcmd/linux$bits/steamclient.so" 2> /dev/null | head -n 1)"; fi if [ -n "$lib" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.steam/sdk$bits" ln -sf "$(readlink -f "$lib")" "$HOME/.steam/sdk$bits/steamclient.so" fi done
# Lets the agent start java, xvfb-run or env first (see the start line). printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "$@"\n' > "node/bin/gse_start.sh" chmod +x "node/bin/gse_start.sh"
